This beans plot is small and beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does — they make their own goodness in the soil. If I get any FISP coupon this year, I will put that fertilizer on my maize plot, not here. I will plant seed I saved from last season, and I will weed by hand with my family. Pesticide is too expensive and I have never needed it for beans.
